title: Discover Career Possibilities
text: Explore a wide range of jobs, learning pathways, and the qualifications and skills needed.
cdi_links: 4.E.01 Considering what jobs and roles are interesting

title: Introduction
text: In this lesson, you will explore
bullets: A wide range of possible jobs and careers
How to research job roles and opportunities
How your skills and values connect to jobs
Where to find reliable career information

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can research a job role that interests me
I can explain why the job role interests me
I can describe the tasks involved in the job
I can explain how the job matches my skills and values

title: Key Words
bullets: Labour Market – The world of work, including jobs, skills, and opportunities.
Job Research – Finding out more about a job, including tasks, skills, and working environment.
Transferable Skills – Abilities that can be used in many different jobs, such as communication, teamwork, and problem solving.

title: Understanding Your Options
bullets: The world of work includes many different sectors and job roles.
Reliable information helps you make informed choices about your future.
Learning pathways such as university, college, or apprenticeships lead to different careers.
Planning ahead helps you develop the skills and qualifications needed for jobs.

title: Job Research
bullets: Job research means learning what a job is really like.
Find out what tasks people do each day.
Identify the skills and qualifications needed.
Understand the type of working environment.

title: Think About
bullets: What kind of work makes you feel motivated?
Do you prefer working with people, information, or things?
What kind of environment helps you do your best work?

title: Activity – Types of Work
text: Use the pages in the booklet to help you through the activity.

title: Researching Jobs
text: Fill in the blanks to complete the sentences about job research.

title: Key Takeaways
bullets: Research helps you understand what jobs are really like
Your interests, values, and skills influence career choices
Exploring job sectors helps you discover new opportunities
